mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) may inhibit loperamide metabolism and potentiate its CNS and anticholinergic effects, with theoretical risk of serotonin syndrome if loperamide has serotonergic activity.
action: Avoid concurrent use or monitor closely for CNS depression, anticholinergic effects, and signs of serotonin syndrome; consider alternative antidiarrheal agents.
